items.title: Wildfire Risk is Increasing. Rising Insurance Costs Are Pushing Hotels to Prepare
items.summary: As wildfires grow more frequent and severe, insurers are no longer pricing risk by location alone — they’re underwriting based on how resilient a property is, pushing operators to firm up their hotels.

items.title: CitizenM, 1 Year Later: Learning to Love Marriott Audits and New Bonvoy Guests
items.summary: Selling your brand to a major group and staying on to run the hotels is an unusual move. A year in, the distribution lift is real. Whether Marriott can now grow CitizenM beyond its original backer is the open question.

items.title: Skift Brings Data + AI Summit to Europe for the First Time
items.summary: Nearly every travel company now claims to be deploying AI. Far fewer can show the outcome, and Europe's rules and languages make proof harder to reach than anywhere else. The Skift Data + AI Summit Europe is where leaders close that distance.

items.title: Most Airlines Are Holding Back on Capacity — American Is Flying More
items.summary: American has made some capacity cuts, but they’re much more modest compared to that of its chief rivals Delta and United. Executives at the carrier said they were taking a more conservative approach to cuts due to volatility around fuel prices.
